node.title: XR prize primitive rank-two shell band
node.statement: At the three prize P-A rows, a minimal uniform Maxwell core has at most 384, 448, and 960 blocks. Composing these exact row-only caps with the rank-two shell deficit shows that no rank-two relation can be active on every core block for shell depths 2<=d<=22,428,333; 19,217,048; and 4,478,600, respectively, at any affine kernel rank where the shell exists. The endpoint test is exact for the uniform deficit bound. Proper local rank-two circuits, larger shell depths, higher trade rank, and nonuniform cells remain open.
